requirements.quote:
replacing or racing Initial packets.  Once valid Initial packets have
   been exchanged, subsequent Handshake packets are protected with the
   Handshake keys, and an on-path attacker cannot force handshake
   failure other than by dropping packets to cause endpoints to abandon
   the attempt.
requirements.condition: Once valid Initial packets have been exchanged.
requirements.required_behavior: Protect subsequent Handshake packets with the Handshake keys.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not process subsequent Handshake packets without Handshake-key protection.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime or static test can verify that Handshake packets sent or accepted after valid Initial packet exchange use Handshake-key protection.
